description: Set a player's ban state in this app: "none" (lift), "banned" (the app shows the ban message and blocks play), "terminated" (wipes the player's local data in the browser and disconnects them — irreversible for that data), "community_muted" (can play but cannot publish, rate or report in the community). Takes effect live. Confirm with the developer before banned/terminated.
name: neblla_set_ban_status
